title: New user? Start here · the AI Foundry ET-SoC-1 lab
description: New user of the AI Foundry ET-SoC-1 lab? Step 0: a Tailscale invite from Roman, by DM on the AI Foundry Discord. Then, from your terminal: create your account, start Claude on a lab machine, paste one line into Claude, and claim your card in #community-lab.
